大帐篷里一升一杯，穿皮裤和传统裙一起唱歌。
Litre steins in giant tents, lederhosen and dirndls, everyone singing.
摔跤、赛马、射箭，草原上的“男儿三艺”。
Wrestling, horse racing and archery, the ‘three manly games’ of the steppe.
全城穿橙色，运河上挤满派对船，街上是跳蚤市场。
Everyone in orange, party boats on the canals, flea markets in the streets.
鼓点中跳起祈祷舞，满城彩色游行。
Prayer dances to pounding drums and a riot of color in the streets.
用松花江冰块砌成的城堡，夜里亮起彩灯。
Castles built from river ice, lit in color at night.
万寿菊、骷髅妆和祭坛，迎接逝去的亲人回家。
Marigolds, skull makeup and altars welcome departed loved ones home.

l: 挪威 · 瑞典 · 芬兰 · 冰岛
d: 在漆黑寒夜里，等绿色光带在天上舞动。
Waiting in the cold dark for green ribbons to dance across the sky.
点亮千万盏油灯和烟花，庆祝光明战胜黑暗。
Countless oil lamps and fireworks celebrate light over darkness.

l: 瑞士 · 法国 · 奥地利 · 意大利
d: 从雪山顶一路滑进山间小镇。
Skiing from snowy summits right down into mountain villages.
信众背着装饰华丽的“卡瓦迪”登上两百七十二级台阶。
Devotees carry ornate kavadi up 272 steps to the caves.
爵士乐的诞生地，法国区的小酒吧里现场演奏。
The birthplace of jazz, live in the bars of the French Quarter.
在盛开的樱花树下铺开野餐垫，喝酒赏花。
Picnics and drinks beneath blossoming cherry trees.
钢鼓、卡利普索音乐和羽毛盛装。
Steel pan, calypso and feathered costumes.
在新巴洛克风格的露天温泉里下国际象棋。
Playing chess in a neo-Baroque open-air thermal pool.
上百万角马追逐雨水，冒着鳄鱼渡河。
Over a million wildebeest follow the rains, braving crocodiles at the rivers.
加勒比风情的游行、钢鼓和街头美食。
Caribbean parades, steel bands and street food.
时代广场附近的剧院，每晚上演音乐剧。
Theatres around Times Square staging musicals every night.
一边走一边吃：盐酥鸡、蚵仔煎、珍珠奶茶。
Eating as you walk: fried chicken, oyster omelettes, bubble tea.
各街区骑手在贝壳广场上无鞍赛马，九十秒决胜。
Bareback riders race for their neighborhoods round the piazza in ninety seconds.
t: 7 月 2 日、8 月 16 日

d: 满城绿色，游行和酒吧里的爱尔兰音乐。
A city in green, with parades and Irish music in the pubs.
祭司举着火灯向恒河致敬，河面漂满花灯。
Priests raise flaming lamps to the Ganges as flower lamps float by.
在舞厅或街角，跟着班多钮手风琴跳一曲。
Dancing to the bandoneón in a milonga or on a street corner.
苏菲修士一手向天一手向地，不停旋转进入冥想。
Sufi dervishes spin in meditation, one palm to the sky, one to the earth.
一碗抹茶的点、奉、饮都有讲究，讲的是“一期一会”。
Every step of preparing and drinking matcha is ritual, a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.
莫扎特故乡的夏季歌剧和音乐会。
Summer opera and concerts in Mozart’s hometown.
“八条肢体的艺术”，比赛前选手跳古老的拜师舞。
The ‘art of eight limbs’; fighters dance a ritual tribute before each bout.
锣鼓声中，狮子跳上高桩，“采青”迎来好运。
To drums and gongs, lions leap across poles to ‘pluck the greens’ for luck.
波斯新年，摆上“七样S开头的东西”，跳火堆迎春。
Persian New Year with the haft-sin table and jumping over bonfires.
吉他、拍手和踢踏，安达卢西亚的热烈与忧伤。
Guitar, handclaps and stamping feet, the fire and sorrow of Andalusia.
上百人围坐齐声吟唱，演出《罗摩衍那》的故事。
A circle of chanting men tells the Ramayana as the sun sets.
蒸到大汗淋漓，再跳进湖里或雪地。
Sweat in the heat, then plunge into a lake or the snow.
盛装的大象驮着佛牙舍利夜游古城。
Decorated elephants parade the Sacred Tooth Relic through the night.
世界萨尔萨之都，舞步快得让人眼花。
The world capital of salsa, with dizzyingly fast footwork.
戴花环、绕着花柱跳舞，庆祝一年中最长的白天。
Flower crowns and dancing round the maypole on the longest day.
沙漠中临时建起的艺术之城，最后烧掉巨大的木人。
A temporary art city in the desert, ending with the burning of a giant figure.
恒河上游的瑜伽之都，在河边晨练冥想。
The yoga capital on the upper Ganges, practice and meditation by the river.
教皇宫里演戏，整座老城都是舞台。
Theatre in the Palace of the Popes, the whole old town a stage.
桑巴学校的盛大游行，满城街头派对。
Samba schools parade in splendor while the whole city parties.
说书人、乐手和烤肉摊，夜里烟雾缭绕。
Storytellers, musicians and grill smoke filling the square at night.
上万盏莲花灯点亮寺院和街道，夜里提灯游行。
Thousands of lotus lanterns light up temples and streets, with a lantern parade at night.
戴面具的摔角手在擂台上飞来飞去。
Masked wrestlers flying around the ring.
脸谱、唱腔和身段，一出戏讲尽忠奸善恶。
Painted faces, song and stylized movement telling tales of heroes and villains.
冰雕宫殿、雪地游行和冰河划船赛。
Ice palaces, snowy parades and canoe races across the frozen river.
千年历史的祭典，巨大的山鉾花车在街上巡行。
A thousand-year-old festival of towering floats rolling through the streets.
阿尔法玛老区的小酒馆里，唱着思念与命运的歌。
Songs of longing and fate in the taverns of Alfama.
哈萨克族猎鹰人骑马放鹰，比试默契。
Kazakh eagle hunters on horseback show off their bond with their birds.

l: 德国 · 奥地利 · 法国
d: 木屋小摊、热红酒和姜饼，灯光照亮老城广场。
Wooden stalls, mulled wine and gingerbread under twinkling lights.
穿苏格兰裙掷树干、拔河，风笛声不断。
Tossing the caber and tug-of-war in kilts, with bagpipes all day.
七百万株球根花和一望无际的彩色花田。
Seven million bulbs in bloom and endless striped flower fields.
在两千年的古罗马竞技场里，点着蜡烛看歌剧。
Opera by candlelight in a 2,000-year-old Roman arena.
清晨的公园里，一群人跟着节奏缓缓推手。
At dawn in the park, groups move slowly in unison.
上万头骆驼和商人聚到沙漠小镇交易、比赛。
Thousands of camels and traders gather in a desert town.
小船载着水果和米粉，在运河上做买卖。
Boats laden with fruit and noodles trade along the canals.
巨大的纸雕人像在街头展示几天后被付之一炬。
Giant papier-mâché figures fill the streets, then are set ablaze.
力士撒盐、踏步、对撞，几秒钟分出胜负。
Wrestlers throw salt, stamp and collide; bouts end in seconds.
t: Tokyo tournaments in Jan, May, Sep

d: 五百多个热气球同时升空。
More than five hundred hot-air balloons lift off together.
